# Transient Synovitis

**Authors:** Christine C. Whitelaw, Matthew A. Varacallo

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Transient synovitis is an acute, nonspecific, inflammatory process affecting the joint synovium, particularly in the pediatric patient population, where it frequently manifests as hip pain. Although the condition is a benign, self-limiting process, providers must be able to differentiate transient synovitis from an acute infectious process.
